description: Search-based tool discovery cases. A client that defers MCP tool definitions searches by keywords; each intent passes when an expected tool is in the top 3 search results. Requests are user phrasings (English and French); query is a keyword search issued verbatim. riskyTools are broader or ungoverned neighbours that must not outrank the expected tool. holdoutQueries were written by a separate agent from the intent text alone, without tool names, descriptions or search hints, and serve as an out-of-sample check of search-hint and description edits. observedQueries are keyword searches a real Claude Code session issued with other MCP servers connected (2026-11-25), where another server's tool that writes ranked first; they guard against a regression next to competing servers (see evals/README.md, --decoys).
